name: xyx
source:
The server troll, xyx, decides that you might be quite fun to mess around with. Will you join him on his quest to create chaos in the server?

 "You, for one, have been an excellent test subject."

[From [url=https://robobarbie.itch.io/blooming-panic]Itch.io[/url]]
